name: Split Text Nav
description: Full-screen vertical link menu in large type where each link flips letter by letter on hover from a serif italic face to a bold sans italic face while sliding sideways.
contents: Vertical list of large text links centered on a solid background
behavior: On hover each character rotates away in 3D with a staggered delay while the alternate font face rotates in
The link slides horizontally by a set distance on hover
Renders after mount to avoid server and client mismatch
editableByProps: Link labels, URLs and number of links
Font size, both font faces, hover slide distance and letter stagger

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the letter rotation axis or angle on hover
needsCodeEdit.where: rotate3d classes on the character spans

fixed: Loads Playfair Display and Roboto from Google Fonts through an @import inside the component
Section fills at least the viewport height with its own background
